predictor.notes: Best-supported predictor: all-units pricing at 2836 cents per unit for quantities 1–218, 1900 for 219–745, and 762 for 746–1000. It matches all 24 observed estimates exactly; every response reported roundingCents=0. Both inferred transitions were checked at adjacent quantities: 218/219 and 745/746. Used 24 business requests and 10 REA operations, including inspection. Unqueried quantities are predictions; additional narrow bands or other departures between observations cannot be ruled out.
